tagline: We help the world sustainably move, improve and enjoy water, life's most essential resource.
hero_kpi_rationale: The transformation program is the primary driver of the company's strategy to accelerate growth and improve margins, focusing on operational excellence and complexity reduction.

kpis.name: Flow Segment Percentage
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue represented by the Flow segment as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.description: The Flow segment is one of Pentair's three primary reporting segments, including flow solutions for industrial and commercial applications.
kpis.signal: Major business segment representing more than one-third of total revenue.

kpis.name: Water Solutions Segment Percentage
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue represented by the Water Solutions segment as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.description: The Water Solutions segment was reorganized effective January 1, 2026, to include residential and irrigation activities previously reported within the Flow segment.
kpis.signal: Segment with potential growth following the reorganization in January 2026.

kpis.name: Pool Segment Percentage
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue represented by the Pool segment as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.description: The Pool segment remains unchanged following the January 2026 reorganization and continues to be Pentair's largest segment.
kpis.signal: Largest segment in terms of contribution to total revenue.

kpis.name: Hydra-Stop Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Hydra-Stop, LLC for $292.1 million within the Flow segment.
kpis.description: Hydra-Stop manufactures specialized insertion valves, line stop fittings, and installation equipment for industrial applications.
kpis.signal: Strategic strengthening in the Flow segment for specialized insertion valves.

kpis.name: G F Manufacturing Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of G F Manufacturing, LLC for $116.0 million within the Pool segment.
kpis.description: G F Manufacturing manufactures and services pool heat pumps, complementing the Pool segment's offering.
kpis.signal: Expansion into the pool heat pump market and enhancement of services.

risks.title: Litige amiante
risks.summary: Pentair is involved in asbestos-related litigation, which could result in negative financial consequences.
risks.score_rationale: Referenced in Item 1A, asbestos litigation could have a negative impact on the company's financial position.

risks.title: Inflation and supply chain costs
risks.summary: Inflation and customs tariffs continue to increase costs for Pentair, negatively impacting financial results despite price increases.
risks.score_rationale: Inflation is mentioned as a risk factor in Item 7, with cost increases for raw materials, tariffs, and logistics expenses.

risks.title: Tarifs douaniers
risks.summary: Tariffs continue to negatively impact Pentair's financial results by increasing costs and disrupting the supply chain.
risks.score_rationale: Tariffs are mentioned as a risk factor in Item 7, with rising costs and supply chain pressures.

risks.title: Concurrence
risks.summary: Pentair faces increasing competition in its markets, which could negatively impact its financial results if it fails to maintain its competitive position.
risks.score_rationale: Competition is cited as a risk factor in Item 7, with pressures on pricing and the need to maintain a competitive position.

risks.title: Regulatory and legal changes risks
risks.summary: Pentair faces regulatory risks, with potential changes in laws and regulations that could negatively impact its financial results.
risks.score_rationale: Regulatory risks are discussed in Item 7, with potential changes in laws and regulations that could negatively impact Pentair's financial results.

risks.title: Changes in key leadership
risks.summary: Changes in key leadership could impact the continuity of management and the company's strategy.
risks.score_rationale: The change of General Counsel in August 2025 and other executive changes could affect operational continuity.
